name: Project: Perfectly Normal
source:
Project X, a top secret privately funded project designed to train the ultimate assassins, was recently shut down under government orders. Now, dozens of children trained under the program are orphaned. In order to solve this situation and offer these children a second chance at life, the government has created a special foster program.

For seventeen years, Ren has trained to be the perfect killer. Now that Project X has ended, Ren has been relocated to a foster family. In a small and normal town, Ren has made it his next mission to become the perfect normal person. Unfortunately, there’s also bunch of people who wish to kill him along the way.

[From [url=https://peaceful-pastel.itch.io/project-perfectly-normal]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
“X计划”是一项由私人资助、旨在培养终极刺客的绝密项目，最近被政府下令关闭。如今，数十名接受过训练的孩子无依无靠。为解决这一问题，让他们有机会重新开始人生，政府设立了一项特殊的寄养计划。

十七年来，Ren一直接受训练，目标是成为完美的杀手。X计划结束后，他被安置到一个寄养家庭。在一座平凡的小镇里，Ren为自己定下了新的任务，成为一个完美的普通人。遗憾的是，这一路上还有不少人想杀了他。

[摘自[url=https://peaceful-pastel.itch.io/project-perfectly-normal]Itch.io[/url]]
